title: Leer's investigation of magnetic anomalies at Coburn's house

tellings.quote: he wanted me to come over and check out my house and we found all kinds of anomalies, anomalous magnetic fields, um leaves and the uh the trunk of the avocado tree had become magnetized.

plain: Steve Coburn, a witness living in Fillmore, California, says Roger Leer, a doctor who studies what he believes are alien implants, came to check out his house. Coburn says they found all kinds of unusual magnetic fields there. According to him, even leaves and the trunk of his avocado tree had become magnetised.
